# Generated by scripts/kehillah_writing_sparks.py. Do not edit by hand.

# Scope: a writer. Grants one new spark in FORM, then lets held sparks ripen.
kehillah_spark_grant_torah_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_can_gain_torah_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_torah value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_text_good title = kehillah_spark_new_toast_t desc = kehillah_spark_new_torah left_icon = this }
		}
	}
}

# A held spark deepens when its next rung is met. Insight to Chiddush:
# discipline aptitude. Chiddush to Great Work: a landmark niche's conditions.
kehillah_spark_ripen_torah_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_spark_torah ?= 1 kehillah_writing_parshanut_aptitude_value >= kehillah_spark_deepen_aptitude_value }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_torah value = 2 }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_text_good title = kehillah_spark_deepen_toast_t desc = kehillah_spark_deepen_torah left_icon = this } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_spark_torah ?= 2 kehillah_writing_landmark_ready_torah_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_torah value = 3 }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_text_good title = kehillah_spark_great_toast_t desc = kehillah_spark_great_torah left_icon = this } }
	}
}

	}
}
kehillah_spark_ripen_ethics_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_spark_ethics ?= 1 kehillah_writing_machshava_aptitude_value >= kehillah_spark_deepen_aptitude_value }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_ethics value = 2 }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_text_good title = kehillah_spark_deepen_toast_t desc = kehillah_spark_deepen_ethics left_icon = this } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_spark_ethics ?= 2 kehillah_writing_landmark_ready_ethics_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_ethics value = 3 }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_text_good title = kehillah_spark_great_toast_t desc = kehillah_spark_great_ethics left_icon = this } }
	}
}
kehillah_spark_ripen_devotion_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_spark_devotion ?= 1 kehillah_writing_machshava_aptitude_value >= kehillah_spark_deepen_aptitude_value }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_devotion value = 2 }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_text_good title = kehillah_spark_deepen_toast_t desc = kehillah_spark_deepen_devotion left_icon = this } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_spark_devotion ?= 2 kehillah_writing_landmark_ready_devotion_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_devotion value = 3 }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_text_good title = kehillah_spark_great_toast_t desc = kehillah_spark_great_devotion left_icon = this } }
	}
}

kehillah_spark_ripen_all_effect = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_torah } kehillah_spark_ripen_torah_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_midrash } kehillah_spark_ripen_midrash_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_poetry } kehillah_spark_ripen_poetry_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_grammar } kehillah_spark_ripen_grammar_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_chronicle } kehillah_spark_ripen_chronicle_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_talmud } kehillah_spark_ripen_talmud_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_yerushalmi } kehillah_spark_ripen_yerushalmi_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_law } kehillah_spark_ripen_law_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_responsa } kehillah_spark_ripen_responsa_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_minhag } kehillah_spark_ripen_minhag_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_siddur } kehillah_spark_ripen_siddur_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_tradition_history } kehillah_spark_ripen_tradition_history_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_scriptural_law } kehillah_spark_ripen_scriptural_law_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_dialogue } kehillah_spark_ripen_dialogue_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_systematic_dialogue } kehillah_spark_ripen_systematic_dialogue_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_mystical } kehillah_spark_ripen_mystical_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_disputation } kehillah_spark_ripen_disputation_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_translation } kehillah_spark_ripen_translation_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_ethics } kehillah_spark_ripen_ethics_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_devotion } kehillah_spark_ripen_devotion_effect = yes }
}

# Scope: a writer. One new spark from the pool, if any is open.
kehillah_spark_from_study_parshanut_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_sefer_can_write_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_pool_study_parshanut_open_trigger = yes }
		random_list = {
			10 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_gain_torah_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_grant_torah_effect = yes }
			10 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_gain_midrash_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_grant_midrash_effect = yes }
			10 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_gain_poetry_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_grant_poetry_effect = yes }
			10 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_gain_grammar_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_grant_grammar_effect = yes }
			10 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_gain_chronicle_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_grant_chronicle_effect = yes }
		}
	}
	kehillah_spark_ripen_all_effect = yes
}

# Scope: the author starting a project. Uses up the chosen form's spark.
kehillah_spark_consume_current_effect = {
	if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:torah } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_torah }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:midrash } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_midrash }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:poetry } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_poetry }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:grammar } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_grammar }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:chronicle } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_chronicle }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:talmud } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmud }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:yerushalmi } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_yerushalmi }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:law } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_law }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:responsa } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_responsa }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:minhag } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_minhag }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:siddur } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_siddur }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:tradition_history } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_tradition_history }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:scriptural_law } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_scriptural_law }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:dialogue } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_dialogue }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:systematic_dialogue } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_systematic_dialogue }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:mystical } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_mystical }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:disputation } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_disputation }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:translation } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_translation }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:ethics } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_ethics }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:devotion } remove_variable = kehillah_spark_devotion }
}
